conbody.p: The warning light indicates situations that require the driver to pay attention.

note.p: Make sure that all warning lights are OFF after starting the vehicle. If any light is still ON, this indicates a situation that needs attention.

li.p: When the high voltage battery level is too low or voltage is decreasing (Output limit occurs when the charge level is insufficient.).

li.p: If both Power down indicator light and Service warning light illuminate at the same time, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: High voltage battery level warning light

sectiondiv.p: When the high voltage battery level is low.
Immediately charge the vehicle. The vehicle can drive an additional 30-40 km.

li.p: The actual distance to empty depends on the driving conditions.

section.title: Parking brake & brake fluid warning light

li.p: Once you set the EV button to the POWER ON position.
It illuminates for approximately 3 seconds
It remains on if the parking brake is applied.
When the parking brake is applied.
When the brake fluid level in the reservoir is low.
If the warning light illuminates with the parking brake released, it indicates the brake fluid level in reservoir is low.

sectiondiv.ph: If the brake fluid level in the reservoir is low:

li.p: Drive carefully to the nearest safe location and stop your vehicle.

With the vehicle stopped, check the brake fluid level immediately and add fluid as required (For more details, refer to ). Then check all brake components for fluid leaks. If any leak on the brake system is still found, the warning light remains on, or the brakes do not operate properly, do not drive the vehicle.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

sectiondiv.p: Your vehicle is equipped with dual-diagonal braking systems. This means you still have braking on two wheels even if one of the dual systems should fail.
With only one of the dual systems working, more than normal pedal travel and greater pedal pressure are required to stop the vehicle.
Also, the vehicle will not stop in as short a distance with only a portion of the brake system working.
If the brakes fail while you are driving, shift to a lower gear for additional braking and stop the vehicle as soon as it is safe to do so.

note.p: Parking brake & brake fluid warning light
Driving the vehicle with a warning light ON is dangerous. If the parking brake & brake fluid warning light illuminates with the parking brake released, it indicates that the brake fluid level is low.
In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

In this case, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD) system warning light
When both ABS and parking brake & brake fluid warning lights are on, the brake system will not work normally and you may experience an unexpected and dangerous situation during sudden braking.
In this case, avoid high speed driving and abrupt braking.
Have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

li.p: When there is a malfunction with the TPMS.

li.p: Significantly low tire pressure makes the vehicle unstable and can contribute to loss of vehicle control and increased braking distances.
Continued driving or low pressure tires will cause the tires to overheat and fail.
The TPMS cannot alert you to severe and sudden tire damage caused by external factors.
If you notice any vehicle instability, immediately take your foot off the accelerator pedal, apply the brakes gradually with light force, and slowly move to a safe position off the road.

When the outside temperature on the temperature gauge is below 4 °C (40 °F), a single chime sounds, both the outside temperature gauge and Icy Road Warning indicator blink several times, and then they remain illuminated.
You can activate or deactivate the Icy Road Warning function from the Settings menu in the infotainment system. Select SetupCluster/Head-Up DisplayClusterContent SelectionIcy Road Warning.

note.p: If the Icy Road warning light appears while driving, avoid speeding, rapid acceleration, sudden braking, or sharp turning.
